title: Unknown and Human Confirmation
rawUserRequest: 继续执行全面整改计划的 WI-02：建立 Unknown 四态模型、未知评估、人工确认类型/过期/输出规范，并完成完整 PR、合并、关闭、分支清理和文档对齐流程。

rawRequestSource.reference: user-request: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instruction and continuation authorization

declaredIntent.summary: Represent unknowns and human confirmations as explicit, scoped, expiring evidence instead of silently converting uncertainty into readiness.

outOfScope: Task Outcome and full Status/PR integration (WI-09 and later)

sources.reason: Defines WI-02 unknown states, confirmation boundaries and required documentation alignment.
Repository terminology for evidence, uncertainty and readiness.
Existing approval evidence contract and expiry conventions.
Bounded WI-02 implementation and verification Contract.

riskAssessment.reason: Unknowns and confirmations are safety boundaries; the implementation must preserve explicit uncertainty and reject expired or mis-scoped confirmations.

executionDecision.reason: WI-01 is merged and closed; the user authorized serial execution and WI-02 has a bounded schema/validator/test scope.

preReviewWarnings: Review four-state unknown semantics, confirmation role/scope/expiry binding, fail-closed stop output, and no silent Not Applicable conversion.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Unknown assessment distinguishes knownUnknowns, unresolvedQuestions, assumptions, examinedAreas, unexaminedAreas and evidenceGaps without silently collapsing uncertainty.
Confirmation records distinguish Reviewer, Owner, Security and Release roles and bind object, scope, digest, expiry and decision; stale or mismatched confirmation fails closed.

needs_human_confirmation output contains problem, reason, known/unknown evidence, options, recommendation, consequences, question and STOP default action; Critical approval rejects an OK-only response.
Focused unknown/confirmation negative tests and all required AI/project verification checks pass before PR creation.
The plan WI-02 section lists schema, validator, fail-closed rules and later integration boundary.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: A missing answer, unexamined area or expired confirmation can be misreported as Not Applicable or ready. WI-02 turns uncertainty and human decisions into explicit, scoped, expiring records.
constraints: Keep unknown assessment and human confirmation machine-readable and deterministic.
Never infer a decision from free-form OK, old scope, expired digest or an incorrect actor.
Keep full Task Outcome/Status/PR consumer integration for later Work Items.
intent.rationale: Explicit unknown and confirmation states prevent unsupported readiness claims and make the handoff to a human auditable.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Unknown assessment preserves known, unresolved, assumed, examined, unexamined and evidence-gap distinctions
Role, scope, digest or expiry mismatch blocks confirmation
needs_human_confirmation includes structured stop-default output and rejects OK-only critical approval

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized full serial execution; approval is limited to the WI-02 unknown assessment schema under .ai/schemas.
